newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan electric cable issues up on telecom interest.
newsitem.headline: Japan electric cable issues up on telecom interest.

text.p: Japanese electric cable issues rose by mid-morning on Thursday as keen interest in the telecommunications sector spread to cables, sending some shares to new highs for the year, brokers said.
As of 0050 GMT, Fujikura Ltd was up 10 yen at 1,100, new high for calendar 1997.
Furukawa Electric Co Ltd was up 11 yen at 769, also a new high, while Hitachi Cable Ltd had jumped 20 yen to reach a new high of 1,040.
"Investment to strengthen the infrastructure for information technology is continuing to boost shares such as Fujitsu Ltd," a trader at a foreign brokerage said.
"Construction work is increasing and the earnings outlook for electric cable companies is brightening, which is making it easy to buy the shares."
